links.outcome: Guideline quality of glaucoma management responses with vs without RAG grounding, rated by masked specialists
links.effect: Human-rated composite RAG advantage: GPT 0.119 (95% CI 0.068-0.173), Gemini 0.095 (0.030-0.161), Grok 0.110 (0.033-0.194); pooled 0.114 excluding Gemini.
links.quote: RAG maintained a significant composite advantage over matched non-RAG models for GPT (mean difference=0.119, 95% CI: 0.068–0.173, Wilcoxon P =0.0002), Gemini (mean difference=0.095, 95% CI: 0.030–0.161, P =0.0098), and Grok (mean difference=0.110, 95% CI: 0.033–0.194, P =0.0155).

links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement between two masked specialists on ordinal rubric before adjudication
links.effect: ICC(2,1) 0.074 accuracy, 0.096 key point coverage, 0.003 logical completeness; exact agreement 42.1%, 47.1%, 48.8%.
links.quote: Formal agreement analysis of the pre-adjudication ordinal scores showed limited absolute agreement between the two masked raters.
